fusions.name: Chilled Mist
fusions.desc: Breathes a cone of cold reef water that deals 26 damage to everything caught in it. It ignores resistances. Each hit has a 35% chance to leave the target [Frozen] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Dropped Tail
fusions.desc: Sheds a hardened lump of reef at a target up to 6 tiles away that deals 12 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at full reach, and stuns it for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Basking Still
fusions.desc: Settles you into the reef: you restore 6 health and are veiled for 8 seconds. Enemies notice you 60% later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Sun-Warmed Crust
fusions.desc: In daylight, your armour rises by 15%. Your dodge chance rises by 4% at all times.
